Zeitwerk Analytics.title: Ask HN: anyone used Zeitwerk Analytics?
Zeitwerk Analytics.content: A single forum thread mentions Zeitwerk Analytics in passing. No product details, pricing or customer references are given, and no other participant confirms having used the product. There is no company website linked anywhere in the thread.

Estonia robotics startup.title: European warehouse robotics seed rounds
Estonia robotics startup.content: The article surveys European warehouse robotics seed rounds in general terms. It names no Estonian company and gives no pricing for any product, describing only aggregate round sizes across the region.

CRDT sync IoT.title: Discussion: CRDT sync in industrial settings
CRDT sync IoT.content: Commenters debate CRDT libraries for offline-first sync but disagree on which are production-ready in industrial IoT. No vendor is identified as a market leader and no market-share data is cited by anyone in the thread.

bootstrapped developer-tools revenue.title: One bootstrapper's revenue report
bootstrapped developer-tools revenue.content: A single founder shares their own annual revenue figure for one bootstrapped developer-tools product. The post explicitly says the number is not representative of any wider population and cites no survey data.

OpenAI.title: OpenAI annualised revenue reported
OpenAI.content: Reuters reports OpenAI is on an annualised revenue run rate of $20 billion, based on figures shared with investors this quarter.

OpenAI.title: OpenAI run rate revisited
OpenAI.content: The Information puts OpenAI's annualised run rate at $31 billion, materially above other published estimates, citing documents it has reviewed.

OpenAI.title: What OpenAI actually earns
OpenAI.content: Business Insider estimates OpenAI's annualised revenue at $24 billion and notes that published figures vary widely depending on what counts as recurring revenue.

SpaceX.title: SpaceX headcount
SpaceX.content: Reuters cites roughly 13,000 employees at SpaceX as of its latest filing-derived estimate, a figure the company has not confirmed publicly.

SpaceX.title: SpaceX company page
SpaceX.content: The company's own page lists more than 22,000 employees, a count that includes contractors and former staff who have not updated their profiles.

Salesforce CRM.title: CRM market share 2026
Salesforce CRM.content: Gartner places Salesforce at 21% of worldwide CRM spend, making it the category leader by revenue share.

Salesforce CRM.title: Worldwide CRM tracker
Salesforce CRM.content: IDC's tracker gives Salesforce 32% of CRM software revenue under its own taxonomy, a materially different position from other analysts.

Shein.title: Shein valuation cut
Shein.content: Reuters reports Shein's valuation was cut to $45 billion in the most recent secondary transactions seen by investors.

Shein.title: Shein listing plans
Shein.content: Bloomberg reports advisers are targeting a $66 billion valuation for a listing, well above the level implied by recent secondary sales.

Palantir.title: Palantir pricing on G2
Palantir.content: G2 reviewers report mid-market contracts starting around $150,000 per year, though several note that pricing is negotiated and never published.

Palantir.title: Palantir buyer reports
Palantir.content: Capterra buyer reports describe entry contracts closer to $400,000 per year for comparable deployment sizes, with wide variation by module.
